show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Darren Farber - The Business of Defense - [Invest Like the Best, EP.417]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Darren is a Managing Partner of Albion River.
reader_summary.overview: Darren is a Managing Partner of Albion River, a private direct investment firm focused on acquiring companies that produce highly technical Defense Products & Services. He is a Former special advisor to the Deputy Under Secretary of Defense, a Former member of U.S. Department of Defense Task Force for Business and Stability Operations, and the list goes on and on.

key_points.text: Darren is a wealth of knowledge in this space and someone I am grateful to have in the US corner.
He shares his perspective on the changing role of the U.S.
in global defense and how recent conflicts have shaped military technology and strategy.
